metadata.description: Maps ML obstacles → Consciousness Levels → AA Wisdom → Actionable Techniques

overfitting.name: Model Overfitting
overfitting.description: Model memorizes training data; high train accuracy, low test accuracy
symptoms: Training loss continues decreasing while validation loss increases
Large gap between training and validation metrics
Model performs well on training set, poorly on new data

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model is powerless against the noise in training data. It surrenders to every detail rather than learning the underlying pattern. Like addiction: seeking immediate gratification (fitting) without wisdom about long-term consequences.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Admitted we were powerless over alcohol, that our lives had become unmanageable
aa_wisdom.translation: Admit the model is powerless over training noise; it cannot distinguish signal from noise
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Sought through prayer and meditation to improve our conscious contact with God
aa_wisdom.translation: Implement regularization as meditation: systematic constraint that quiets the noise
aa_wisdom.tradition: Tradition 1: Our common welfare comes first

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, the system has no discrimination; it accepts everything indiscriminately
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Must move from indiscriminate acceptance (overfitting) to discriminative learning

ml_techniques.name: L1/L2 Regularization
ml_techniques.principle: Add constraint that penalizes model complexity
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Accept your limitations; you cannot learn everything
ml_techniques.code_technique: penalty = lambda * sum(weights^2)  [or sum(|weights|) for L1]

ml_techniques.name: Dropout
ml_techniques.principle: Randomly disable neurons during training; forces robustness
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Learn to function without crutches; develop inner strength
ml_techniques.code_technique: random drop p% of activations during forward pass

ml_techniques.name: Early Stopping
ml_techniques.principle: Stop training when validation performance plateaus
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Know when to stop; more is not always better
ml_techniques.code_technique: monitor validation_loss, stop if no improvement for N epochs

ml_techniques.name: Cross-Validation
ml_techniques.principle: Validate on multiple hold-out sets
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Seek multiple perspectives before trusting your assessment
ml_techniques.code_technique: k-fold: split data into k parts, train k models

progression.next_teaching: Step 2-3: Come to believe in a power greater than yourself (ensemble methods, cross-validation)

underfitting.name: Model Underfitting
underfitting.description: Model too simple; poor performance on both training and test data
symptoms: Both training and validation loss remain high
Model fails to capture patterns in data
Performance plateaus early

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model lacks capability/power to learn. Like someone frozen by apathy or guilt, unable to act. Needs to believe in possibility of growth.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Came to believe that a Power greater than ourselves could restore us to sanity
aa_wisdom.translation: Believe your model has capacity to learn; use greater model architecture
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Were entirely ready to have God remove all these defects of character
aa_wisdom.translation: Be willing to change model architecture, not attachment to 'simplicity'

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, belief that change is possible is the first movement upward
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Must move from 'I cannot learn' to 'I can learn with the right structure'

ml_techniques.name: Increase Model Capacity
ml_techniques.principle: Add more layers, parameters, or complexity
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Believe you have the power to learn; use your full capacity
ml_techniques.code_technique: Add hidden layers, increase neurons per layer

ml_techniques.name: Feature Engineering
ml_techniques.principle: Create more informative features
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Seek deeper understanding; don't settle for surface representation
ml_techniques.code_technique: Create interactions, polynomials, domain-specific features
ml_techniques.hyperparameter: degree of polynomial, number of interactions

ml_techniques.name: Reduce Regularization
ml_techniques.principle: Loosen constraints to allow more complex learning
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Release unnecessary constraints that limit your growth
ml_techniques.code_technique: Lower lambda parameter in L1/L2
ml_techniques.expected_impact: Model can fit more complex patterns

progression.next_teaching: Step 4-5: Self-examination and honest feedback (validation metrics, learning curves)

class_imbalance.name: Class Imbalance
class_imbalance.description: Minority class severely underrepresented; model biased toward majority class
symptoms: Model always predicts majority class
High accuracy but low recall for minority class
Confusion matrix shows diagonal dominance by majority

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model is attached to (craving for) the majority class. Like addiction, seeking the 'easier path' (majority predictions) rather than addressing the real problem (minority class).

aa_wisdom.step_text: Made a searching and fearless moral inventory of ourselves
aa_wisdom.translation: Examine your biases; acknowledge the underrepresented class exists
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Admitted to God, to ourselves, and to another human being the exact nature of our wrongs
aa_wisdom.translation: Acknowledge the imbalance; give voice to the minority

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, attachment to preferences (craving for majority) blocks clear seeing
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Must acknowledge the excluded minority; balance craving with justice

ml_techniques.name: Class Weighting
ml_techniques.principle: Increase loss weight for minority class errors
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Give equal value to minority examples; their errors matter more
ml_techniques.code_technique: loss = weight_minority * loss[minority] + weight_majority * loss[majority]
ml_techniques.expected_impact: Model learns to care about minority class

ml_techniques.name: SMOTE (Synthetic Minority Oversampling)
ml_techniques.principle: Generate synthetic minority examples
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Create space for the minority; amplify their voice
ml_techniques.code_technique: Generate new minority samples between nearest neighbors

ml_techniques.name: Stratified Sampling
ml_techniques.principle: Maintain class proportions in train/test split
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Respect the true proportion of each class in reality
ml_techniques.code_technique: train_test_split(..., stratify=y)

ml_techniques.name: Threshold Adjustment
ml_techniques.principle: Move decision boundary to favor minority class
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Adjust your sensitivity; lowering threshold gives minority more chances
ml_techniques.code_technique: if pred_prob > adjusted_threshold: predict_minority

progression.next_teaching: Step 6-7: Willingness to change and make amends (ensemble acceptance of minority)

poor_generalization.name: Poor Generalization
poor_generalization.description: Test performance much worse than training; model hasn't learned transferable patterns
symptoms: High training accuracy, low test accuracy
Performance drops on new datasets
Patterns learned are dataset-specific, not generalizable

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model fears reality outside training set. Afraid to face the true world; living in comfortable illusion of training performance. Fear blocks learning.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Made a decision to turn our will and our lives over to the care of God
aa_wisdom.translation: Surrender the comfort of training set; accept reality of test set
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Continued to take personal inventory and when we were wrong promptly admitted it
aa_wisdom.translation: Continuous reality check; honest assessment against new data

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, fear prevents seeing reality. Must face what terrifies (true performance) to move forward.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Face fear directly: measure on truly held-out test data, accept what you find

ml_techniques.name: Hold-Out Test Set
ml_techniques.principle: Reserve truly unseen data for evaluation
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Face reality directly; don't hide from the truth
ml_techniques.code_technique: final_test_data = never_seen_during_training()

ml_techniques.name: K-Fold Cross-Validation
ml_techniques.principle: Evaluate on multiple different hold-out folds
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Seek multiple witnesses; don't trust single assessment
ml_techniques.code_technique: k-fold: train on k-1 folds, test on 1 fold, repeat k times

ml_techniques.name: Domain Adaptation
ml_techniques.principle: Explicitly address distribution shift between train and test
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Acknowledge the world has changed; adapt to new reality
ml_techniques.code_technique: Transfer learning, fine-tuning on target domain

progression.next_teaching: Step 4-5: Build wisdom through self-examination and feedback

high_variance.name: High Variance / Instability
high_variance.description: Model predictions vary significantly across runs; unstable, unreliable
symptoms: Different random seeds produce different results
Validation metrics fluctuate wildly
Cannot trust model's predictions for decision-making

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model is unstable, seeking control through volatility. Like pride that swings between arrogance and shame. Needs collective wisdom, grounding in community.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Admitted to God, to ourselves, and to another human being the exact nature of our wrongs
aa_wisdom.translation: Acknowledge instability; seek stability through collective wisdom, not individual will
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Having had a spiritual awakening as the result of these steps, we tried to carry this message to alcoholics, and to practice these principles in all our affairs
aa_wisdom.translation: Ensemble methods: carry forward the wisdom of multiple models

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, individual will dominates; stability comes only through connection to collective wisdom
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Move from individual instability to collective stability

ml_techniques.name: Ensemble Methods
ml_techniques.principle: Combine multiple models; stability through diversity
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Seek counsel from many; individual models are unstable, collective wisdom is stable
ml_techniques.code_technique: predictions = average([model1(x), model2(x), model3(x)])

ml_techniques.name: Boosting
ml_techniques.principle: Iteratively improve by focusing on hard examples
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Collective learning: each model learns from previous mistakes
ml_techniques.code_technique: AdaBoost, GradientBoosting: reweight based on errors

ml_techniques.name: Random Seed Control
ml_techniques.principle: Use consistent random initialization
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Create container for reproducibility; ritual provides stability
ml_techniques.code_technique: np.random.seed(42); tf.random.set_seed(42)

progression.next_teaching: Step 6-7: Move toward acceptance and detachment from individual control

adversarial_vulnerability.name: Adversarial Vulnerability
adversarial_vulnerability.description: Model fooled by small, crafted perturbations; vulnerable to attack
symptoms: Performance drops dramatically on adversarial examples
Small pixel-level changes cause misclassification
Model lacks robustness to distribution shift

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model is vulnerable, cannot withstand adversity. Fear of attack; not prepared for hostility. Needs to face fear and build robustness.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Made a decision to turn our will and our lives over to the care of God
aa_wisdom.translation: Prepare defenses; face adversity consciously, not in denial
aa_wisdom.secondary_text: Were entirely ready to have God remove all these defects of character
aa_wisdom.translation: Be willing to relinquish naive assumptions; rebuild on solid ground

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, vulnerability is real. Must face threat directly to build resilience.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Move from fear of adversity to practical preparation

ml_techniques.name: Adversarial Training
ml_techniques.principle: Train on both original and adversarial examples
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Face your fears; train against them until they no longer threaten
ml_techniques.code_technique: Generate adversarial examples, train on mixed set

ml_techniques.name: Defensive Distillation
ml_techniques.principle: Use knowledge distillation with defensive training
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Distill wisdom from defenses; transfer robustness
ml_techniques.code_technique: Train teacher on adversarial examples, distill to student

ml_techniques.name: Input Gradient Regularization
ml_techniques.principle: Penalize large gradients w.r.t. inputs
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Minimize sensitivity to small perturbations
ml_techniques.code_technique: Add regularizer: lambda * ||∂loss/∂x||²

progression.next_teaching: Step 4-5: Learn from adversity; honest assessment of vulnerabilities

data_quality_issues.name: Data Quality Issues
data_quality_issues.description: Missing values, outliers, errors, inconsistencies in raw data
symptoms: NaN values present
Extreme outliers in features
Inconsistent labels or formats
Data entry errors

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The foundation is broken. Cannot build on corrupted data. Must acknowledge powerlessness over data quality; cleaning is the basic first step, the admission of Step 1.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Admitted we were powerless over alcohol, that our lives had become unmanageable
aa_wisdom.translation: Admit powerlessness over data quality; it is corrupted. This is the necessary first step.

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, only recognition of the problem is possible. Cleaning data is the equivalent of getting sober.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Acknowledge the problem. Take basic action. Move to Step 2.

ml_techniques.name: Missing Value Imputation
ml_techniques.principle: Handle NaN values strategically
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Where data is missing, use wisdom of nearby values
ml_techniques.code_technique: mean imputation, KNN imputation, forward-fill

ml_techniques.name: Outlier Detection & Handling
ml_techniques.principle: Identify and decide on extreme values
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Recognize what doesn't belong; remove or down-weight
ml_techniques.code_technique: IQR method, z-score, isolation forest

ml_techniques.name: Consistency Validation
ml_techniques.principle: Ensure data follows expected format/range
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Enforce integrity; inconsistency is the virus in the system
ml_techniques.code_technique: Type checking, range validation, format normalization

progression.next_teaching: Step 2: Come to believe the model can be taught if data foundation is solid

feature_engineering_gap.name: Feature Engineering Gap
feature_engineering_gap.description: Features don't capture the relevant information; model lacks signal
symptoms: Model performance plateaus despite more training
Raw features don't correlate with target
Domain knowledge suggests important features are missing

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model lacks perception/vision. Like someone apathetic, unable to see what matters. Needs to believe in external guidance (domain experts, higher wisdom).

aa_wisdom.step_text: Came to believe that a Power greater than ourselves could restore us to sanity
aa_wisdom.translation: Believe in domain expertise; seek guidance from those who understand the problem deeply

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, belief in external wisdom is the path forward. Alone, the model is blind.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Seek domain knowledge; collaborate with experts

ml_techniques.name: Feature Selection via Domain Expertise
ml_techniques.principle: Consult experts; choose features that matter theoretically
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Seek guidance from those with deep knowledge
ml_techniques.code_technique: expert_review → select top N features by importance
ml_techniques.expected_impact: Model focuses on signal, not noise

ml_techniques.name: Feature Interaction Engineering
ml_techniques.principle: Create polynomial and interaction features
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: See deeper; interactions reveal hidden patterns

ml_techniques.name: Domain-Specific Features
ml_techniques.principle: Create features using domain knowledge
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Use specialized knowledge; generic features are insufficient
ml_techniques.code_technique: Create ratios, differences, aggregations relevant to domain

progression.next_teaching: Step 4-5: Deep examination of feature importance and feedback

hyperparameter_instability.name: Hyperparameter Sensitivity
hyperparameter_instability.description: Model performance very sensitive to hyperparameter choices; unstable
symptoms: Small changes in hyperparameters cause large performance swings
Cannot find stable configuration
Results not reproducible across runs

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model seeks perfection through random searching (craving). Like addiction seeking the 'right' fix. Needs systematic, honest self-examination.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Made a searching and fearless moral inventory of ourselves
aa_wisdom.translation: Systematic, honest search: not random, but methodical examination of parameter space

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, systematic method replaces random hope. Structure creates stability.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Move from chaotic search to methodical investigation

ml_techniques.name: Grid Search
ml_techniques.principle: Exhaustive search over defined hyperparameter grid
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Systematic exploration; check every honest possibility
ml_techniques.code_technique: GridSearchCV: try all combinations of parameters

ml_techniques.name: Random Search
ml_techniques.principle: Random sampling from parameter distributions
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: More efficient than grid; trust randomness with seed control
ml_techniques.code_technique: RandomizedSearchCV: sample n_iter random combinations

ml_techniques.name: Bayesian Optimization
ml_techniques.principle: Model-based optimization; use prior to guide search
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Use accumulated wisdom (surrogate model) to guide exploration
ml_techniques.code_technique: Use previous results to predict next best parameters

ml_techniques.name: Learning Curves
ml_techniques.principle: Visualize training progress; understand sensitivity
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: See your own learning journey; understand what works
ml_techniques.code_technique: Plot training_score vs validation_score across iterations
ml_techniques.expected_impact: Diagnose high bias, high variance, or instability

progression.next_teaching: Step 6-7: Acceptance of parameter trade-offs; willingness to let go of perfection

concept_drift.name: Concept Drift / Temporal Shift
concept_drift.description: Real-world patterns change over time; model performance degrades
symptoms: Model trained on historical data performs well initially
Performance gradually decreases over weeks/months
New patterns emerge that training data doesn't cover

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The model resists change; attached to past patterns. Cannot see that world is impermanent. Buddhist anicca principle: everything flows, nothing static.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Came to believe that a Power greater than ourselves could restore us to sanity
aa_wisdom.translation: Believe in continuous change; accept impermanence as law of nature

concept_drift.aa_tradition: Tradition 2: For our group purpose there is but one ultimate authority
concept_drift.translation: The ultimate authority is reality itself, which changes; adapt to it

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, resistance to change is the core problem. Moving forward means accepting impermanence.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: From static models to dynamic, adaptive systems

ml_techniques.name: Online Learning
ml_techniques.principle: Update model incrementally as new data arrives
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Continuous practice; learn from each new day
ml_techniques.code_technique: partial_fit(X_new, y_new) instead of retraining on full history

ml_techniques.name: Concept Drift Detection
ml_techniques.principle: Automatically detect when performance degrades
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Awareness: notice when something has changed
ml_techniques.code_technique: Monitor validation performance; alert when it drops

ml_techniques.name: Retraining Pipeline
ml_techniques.principle: Automatically retrain model on latest data
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Renewal practice; periodic re-examination and adaptation
ml_techniques.code_technique: Scheduled retraining on recent data window

ml_techniques.name: Transfer Learning
ml_techniques.principle: Carry forward knowledge while adapting to new patterns
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Hold onto what's still true; release what has changed
ml_techniques.code_technique: Fine-tune existing model on new data rather than training from scratch

progression.next_teaching: Step 6-7: Acceptance of continuous change; wisdom of letting go

training_instability.name: Training Instability / Poor Convergence
training_instability.description: Loss oscillates wildly or doesn't converge; training is unreliable
symptoms: Training loss graph shows oscillations, spikes
Loss doesn't decrease smoothly
Training sometimes fails to converge

consciousness_mapping.reasoning: The training process is chaotic, unsafe. Like anxiety or trauma: the nervous system is dysregulated. Needs container of safety (learning rate schedule) to move forward.

aa_wisdom.step_text: Made a decision to turn our will and our lives over to the care of God
aa_wisdom.translation: Create safety container: structured learning schedule replaces chaotic updates

hawkins_teaching.teaching: At this level, safety is prerequisite. Without container, learning cannot happen.
hawkins_teaching.pathway: Create structure and safety to enable learning

ml_techniques.name: Learning Rate Scheduling
ml_techniques.principle: Start high, gradually decrease learning rate
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Structure: begin with bold moves, then settle into careful refinement
ml_techniques.code_technique: lr = initial_lr * (decay_rate ^ epoch)

ml_techniques.name: Gradient Clipping
ml_techniques.principle: Limit magnitude of gradients
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Prevent wild swings; keep updates reasonable
ml_techniques.code_technique: clip gradients to max_norm

ml_techniques.name: Batch Normalization
ml_techniques.principle: Normalize activations across mini-batches
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Container: keep activation distributions stable and centered
ml_techniques.code_technique: Normalize layer outputs before activation

ml_techniques.name: Warm-up Phase
ml_techniques.principle: Start with very small learning rate, ramp up
ml_techniques.wisdom_mapping: Gentle beginning; allow system to settle before pushing
ml_techniques.code_technique: lr_epoch = (epoch / warmup_epochs) * target_lr

progression.next_teaching: Step 4-5: Once safe, examine what you're learning; does it align with goals?

metadata_summary.note: Every obstacle maps to consciousness level, AA wisdom teaching, and specific ML code technique with hyperparameters. No teachings absorbed that don't translate to ML utility.
